title: Closed for Cosmic Reasons
summary: Night infinity pool; laminated sign; the water hovers three feet up, still reflecting the city. She sits dry underneath and uses it as a ceiling. Vivienne energy.
visualArc: Chrome stanchion → hovering water sheet → dry woman in the empty basin → smoke flattening on the underside.

segments.label: Motion (6s)
segments.onScreen: Ripple across hovering water; smoke sheets on the underside; ember pulse; page does not turn.
segments.musicCue: Closed for Cosmic Reasons — title line PA-narrow, half-step flat
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Locked-off 6-second photoreal loop. A slow ripple travels left to right across the hovering water sheet. Cigarette smoke rises, hits the underside, and sheets sideways.
